title: Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ Black Mamba 10ml E-Liquid
description: Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ Black Mamba is an intense, exotic blend of rich, dark Berries, tangy Passion Fruit, and an Icy finish. The deep berry notes create a bold and complex vape, enhanced with a layer of bright, tangy tropical flavour and a cooling exhale that lingers for a refreshingly smooth experience. Designed for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping, this nicotine salt e-liquid delivers fast-acting nicotine satisfaction with a consistently smooth throat hit. The 50/50 VG/PG ratio ensures well-defined flavour while maintaining discreet vapour production, making it an excellent choice for pod kits and vape starter kits. Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ e-liquids provide a cost-effective and sustainable alternative to single-use disposable vapes, bringing popular flavours to a refillable format. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, each bottle features a childproof cap and an easy-fill nozzle for convenience. The ideal companion for any refillable vape device or starter e-cigarette kit setup, designed for convenience.
